evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT dropped to -37.7 in t-0w, the lowest of the four weeks

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days even as WORKPLACES keeps falling and RESIDENTIAL keeps rising, rejecting the compounding substitution mechanism.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC surpasses -9.4 within two weeks and sustains an upward trend, rejecting the stalled-momentum hypothesis.
